description: Unsigned transactions to post a bid for a series at a premium a share: the premium for all the shares is locked now in USDG (exact approval, then postBid) and goes to the writer who fills it, less Borro's share; the option tokens come to this wallet. cancel_order takes it back while it is open.

expiry.description: this (default), next, or a Friday's date like 2026-10-16

premium.description: Premium you bid, USDG a share, in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

shares.description: Shares to bid for, in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

symbol.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: post_bid
title: Prepare: bid for options
